items.title: 13.11.1 Pani mein chlorine ka shamil hona (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11.1, printed page 301.

blocks.text: Jab chlorine gas (Cl₂) pani mein dali jaye to hydrolysis (pani ke saath reaction se toot-na) hoti hai aur hydrochloric acid (HCl) aur chloric (I) acid (HClO) ka mixture banta hai.

Chloric (I) acid (HOCl, yahi HClO hai) weak acid hai; yeh pani mein poora nahi balke thora sa (partially) dissociate (ions mein toot-na) hota hai aur hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur chlorate (I) ions (OCl⁻) banata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Weak acid ka sirf kuch hissa ions mein toot-ta hai: HOCl ⇌ H⁺ + OCl⁻ (double arrow ka matlab hai ke dono taraf reaction chalta rehta hai). Pehli reaction mein chlorine khud disproportionate hoti hai: HCl mein -1 aur HClO mein +1.

items: HOCl weak acid hai: HOCl ⇌ H⁺ + OCl⁻; yahi do active species hain.
